title: pinus sylvestris var. tartarica
intro: Pinus sylvestris var. tartarica, commonly known as Siberian pine, is a variant of the Siberian fir, belonging to the Pinaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the ability to boost the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Siberian pine include its antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Siberian pine include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
